content_data.project_description: A focused initiative to streamline and scale the onboarding of new media partners, leveraging existing integration technologies to reduce time-to-revenue and enhance operational efficiency across global markets.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 9 months, with initial pilot phase completing within 3 months.
objectives: Enhance sales team efficiency by providing standardized integration pathways and resources.
Reduce average partner integration time by 30% within the next 6 months.
Improve data flow reliability and accuracy from new media partners.
deliverables: Training Modules for Sales and Technical Account Managers on new integration processes
Dedicated Integration Support Portal for Sales Teams and Partners
success_metrics: Number of new partners integrated per business cycle
Average time-to-revenue for new partners (measured in days)
Partner satisfaction scores related to onboarding experience
Incremental revenue attributed to accelerated integrations
revenue_targets: Generate 15% higher average deal value from partners onboarded via the new process.
